Alexa S.: Quick sync — Vellichor POC signed today, need model onboard for EOW.
Omar R.: I'll take tech onboarding. Need model artifact (HF link or s3), exact variant names, and a small inference sample that exercises long context.
Alexa S.: Customer will provide HF repo: https://huggingface.co/vellichor/vellichor-16b. Variants: vellichor-16b, vellichor-16b-q4_k, vellichor-16b-q8_0.
Meera K.: FYI security: they flagged KMS/HSM for key management and EU data residency. I've uploaded their security questionnaire: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/Vellichor_Sec_Questionnaire (answers needed by Tue).
Jin T.: Infra notes — if they require HSM and VPC-only control plane, this is a Private deploy. We'll need a sizing estimate: expected concurrency? Also KV-cache compatibility: their model uses standard KV layout but we should run a quick KV-scan.
Billing: Ballpark pricing for hosted: ~$0.012 / 1k tokens for fp16. Quantized q4 variants reduce token compute ~30% => cost ~ $0.0085 / 1k. Dedicated commit would be cheaper long-term; suggest we prepare both hosted and 1/3/6-month commit options.
Omar R.: Next tech tasks I/O: 1) fetch weights and run model variant compatibility sweep (tokenization, kv-cache, length perf). 2) run sample workload (5k requests with seq_len 1k) to capture latency p95. I'll spin up a local run this afternoon.
devrel-bot: Deploy checklist created: /ops/tickets/VEL-1823 — assign to omar_r for onboarding.
LegalBot: They attached a draft MSA. Legal review requested — @legal-team please triage.
Alexa S.: Also a pricing ask: they want per-call pricing for a high-latency fallback path. Can we propose a mixed routing policy (hosted primary, fallback to smaller quantized variant) and show cost delta?
Jin T.: Yes — routing policy feasible. Fallback to vellichor-16b-q4_k with automatic failover on latency > 800ms. I'll estimate perf/tokens after sweep.
Meera K.: Security blocker: they insist on audit logs for model inputs for 90 days. Private deploy handles this; for hosted we can offer 90-day log retention as add-on — ops needs to confirm.
Omar R.: I'll need access to their test corpus (anonymized) to run quality checks vs baseline. Please ask customer to upload to S3 share.
Alexa S.: I'll request S3 share + expected TPS. Also scheduling: can we do a technical call tomorrow 10am PT? @Omar R. @Meera K.
Omar R.: 10am PT works.
Jin T.: I'll join for infra questions.
Billing: I'll prepare pricing scenarios and a back-of-envelope cost model to present in call.
Alexa S.: Great—action items summarized in VEL-1823. Goal: compatibility report + security answers + pricing card before EOW. :thumbsup:
